lines.beaver_en: Hello. What brings you in today?
lines.learner: 요즘 가계 사정이 너무 나빠져서 왔어요.
lines.en: My household finances have gotten really bad lately.
lines.roman: yojeum gagye sajeongi neomu nappajyeoseo wasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me when things got difficult?
lines.learner: 작년에 주식에 거금을 넣었다가 크게 잃었어요.
lines.en: Last year I put a large sum into stocks and lost big.
lines.roman: jangnyeone jusige geogeumeul neoeotdaga keuge ireosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Did you get your original investment back after that?
lines.en: No, far from breaking even, I couldn't even recover half.
Because of stress, I spent a lot on entertainment too.

lines.learner: 급해서 적금을 해약하고 돈을 다 인출했어요.
lines.en: I was desperate, so I canceled it and withdrew everything.
lines.roman: geupaeseo jeokgeumeul haeyakago doneul da inchulhaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Daily life must be very hard for you.
lines.learner: 네, 이러다 빈털터리가 될까 봐 무서워요.
lines.en: Yes, I'm scared I'll end up penniless.
lines.roman: ne, ireoda binteolteoriga doelkka bwa museowoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What is your income right now?
lines.en: I'm barely getting by on my salary.

lines.beaver: 앞으로 돈 관리는 어떻게 하고 싶으세요?
lines.beaver_en: How would you like to manage your money from now on?
lines.beaver_roman: apeuro don gwallineun eotteoke hago sipeuseyo?
lines.learner: 투자는 이제 그만두고 생계부터 챙기고 싶어요.
lines.en: I want to stop investing and take care of my livelihood first.
lines.roman: tujaneun ije geumandugo saenggyebuteo chaenggigo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver: 좋은 생각입니다. 지출 계획부터 세워 봅시다.
lines.beaver_en: Good idea. Let's start with a spending plan.
lines.beaver_roman: joeun saenggagimnida. jichul gyehoekbuteo sewo bopsida.
lines.en: Since we're making a plan, I'll definitely stick to it.

lines.beaver: 네, 다음 주에 다시 같이 점검하겠습니다.
lines.beaver_en: All right, we'll review it together again next week.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, daeum jue dasi gachi jeomgeomhagetseumnida.
lines.en: Thank you. See you next week.
